changelog:
Amazon Listing Analyzer 1.0.0

- Initial release of Amazon Listing Analyzer for mid-level Amazon sellers ($5k–$200k/month, 1–5 years experience)
- Provides listing health score, keyword analysis, competitor benchmarking, and structured optimization suggestions
- All outputs are reference advice generated from built-in rules and templates; no real-time API data
- Supports JSON and conversational inputs for multiple analysis types
- Enforces safety: no external API calls, no storage of sensitive info, input length restriction (≤10,000 chars)
- Unified JSON output structure across all modules
summary: 为中阶 Amazon 卖家提供 Listing 健康度诊断、关键词分析、竞品对标及结构化优化建议，助力提升销售表现。
